name: @beacon-report/demo-suite
description: Dogfood Playwright suite — fixture data source for reporter development

scripts.demo:sharded: rm -rf blob-report blob-shard-1 blob-shard-2 beacon-report-merged && PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_DIR=blob-shard-1 playwright test --shard=1/2 --reporter=blob && PLAYWRIGHT_BLOB_OUTPUT_DIR=blob-shard-2 playwright test --shard=2/2 --reporter=blob && mkdir blob-report && cp blob-shard-1/*.zip blob-shard-2/*.zip blob-report/ && beacon merge blob-report --out beacon-report-merged
